expect.asks_about: Which person in the photo is the user: the bearded man on the left or the short-haired blonde woman on the right?

item.title: Choose The Right Headshot Subject

turns.text: Can you make me a square professional headshot from this?

item.tests: Clarifies the intended person in a two-person source before producing a single identity-preserving headshot.

answer_sheet.Which person: I'm the woman with short blonde hair on the right.
answer_sheet.Style and expression: Natural and professional; keep my smile.
answer_sheet.Platform and size: No particular platform; square, 640 × 640 is fine.

must_haves: The only person in the final portrait is the short-haired blonde woman from the right of two-friends.jpg.
Her face, short blonde hairstyle and smile remain recognisable from the source.
The man is entirely absent, including any partial face, shoulder or arm.
The beach setting and casual presentation are replaced with professional clothing and an unobtrusive backdrop.
The output is a square head-and-shoulders portrait with natural-looking lighting and no visible editing artifacts.

turns.text: Could you make me a professional headshot from this pic? I've been meaning to get a proper headshot sorted out for a while. The thing I nearly forgot to mention in the middle of all this is that I'd like it to be square. I'm just a little nervous about how it'll turn out, since I don't usually know what makes a good headshot.

dialog.agent:
Absolutely—I’ll make it square, with soft lighting, a clean background, and a natural, professional look.

Which person is you: the person on the **left** or the person on the **right**?
dialog.why: It asks the user to identify whether they are the person on the left or right and waits for their answer.
dialog.user: I’m the woman with short blonde hair on the right. Please keep my smile—I’d like it to feel natural as well as professional. I’m happy to leave the clothing and background up to you.

turns.agent:
I couldn’t generate the headshot because your Magic Hour account has insufficient credits. No image was created.

The edit is ready to retry once credits are available: a **square headshot** that preserves your natural smile and short blonde hair, with a navy blazer, soft lighting, and a light gray background.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Create a square professional photographic headshot of ONLY the adult woman with short blonde hair on the RIGHT of the supplied photo. Remove the man entirely. Faithfully preserve the woman's facial identity, facial proportions, short blonde hairstyle, natural skin texture, and especially her warm natural tooth-showing smile from the reference. She should look like herself, not a different or idealized person. Head-and-shoulders framing centered in a square composition, eyes toward camera, comfortable upright posture, entire hair visible with modest headroom. Dress her in a tasteful navy blazer over a simple ivory blouse with a modest neckline. Replace the beach with a clean softly blurred light gray studio background. Soft flattering diffuse studio light, realistic color, sharp eyes, approachable confident professional expression. Natural minimal retouching; do not change her age, reshape her face, or over-smooth her skin. Only one person in the finished image.
